description: Pass new facts from the user to the lawyer handling an existing request: a changed deadline, extra circumstances, a list of documents, a preferred call time. Needs the request number and the phone or e-mail the request was sent with. Does not create a new request. For a closed request send a new one instead.

agent_name.description: Your assistant name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude

contact.description: The phone (with country code) or e-mail given in that request

details.description: What to add, in the user's words

request_number.description: Request number returned when it was sent

name: add_request_details
title: Add details to a request
